build_note: Hexoptics C44 first (55 AD + 25% crit) - triggers headshot every 6 autos or on trap/net. RFC second (25% crit) for empowered long-range headshot at max range. IE third (50% crit from Hexoptics + RFC before IE = IE fully active at 75%). Trap all health pack paths - every trap is a free headshot proc.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 4th - swap to Mortal Reminder vs healing, never both
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies - never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs heavy burst - still reaches IE threshold
kit_notes: Hexoptics C44 headshot triggers after: 6 autos, stepping on trap, or getting hit by net (E). RFC headshot at max range crits for massive damage. Traps at chokepoints force enemies off health packs. E-net to interrupt dashes/escapes. Never use E offensively - it's your escape and net combo.
aram_specific: Trap all 4 health pack approach paths at game start. RFC extends Q and headshot range to 850+ - stay at absolute max range. Enemies stepping on traps give free headshots which crit with RFC active. Never dash forward with E - it's your only escape vs dive.
